description: This file is a jQuery plugin named Readmore.js that provides toggle functionality for collapsing and expanding content blocks with customizable options, including styling, animation speed, and callbacks.

classes.name: Readmore
classes.description: Main class implementing the readmore functionality, handling initialization, toggle behavior, resizing, and destruction of the content sections.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up event handlers, and processes each target element to enable collapse/expand behavior.

methods.name: toggleSlider
methods.description: Handles the toggle action between expanded and collapsed states, updating heights, classes, and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: setBoxHeight
methods.description: Calculates and stores the full height of the content for toggle purposes.

methods.name: resizeBoxes
methods.description: Adjusts the heights of all content sections on window resize.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the plugin styles, event handlers, and cleans up associated data from target elements.
